verdict.rationale: Lowenstein's own Startup/Emerging Companies page names business formation as part of the practice, and its Lowenstein x Clerky offering lets founders incorporate and fully set up a Delaware C corporation. Per that page, setup covers adoption of bylaws, appointment of directors and officers, founder stock issuances and 83(b) forms on venture-grade documents, with published pricing for post-incorporation setup. Missing for 10: explicit mention of the charter/certificate of incorporation and initial board consents as named deliverables (only implied by 'incorporate' and 'appointment of directors'), clarity on attorney-led bespoke formation versus the Clerky platform workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
